name: Syed Modi International
stakes: This week offers a golden opportunity for India's top women shuttlers to clinch prestigious home titles and solidify their growing international presence.
summary:
India's campaign at the Syed Modi International has reached a thrilling climax, with two strong contenders making it to Saturday's finals. Rising star Tanvi Sharma, the second seed in Women's Singles, has been particularly impressive, battling through a tough semifinal against compatriot Unnati Hooda to secure her spot. She now faces Thailand's Supanida Katethong in a bid for her second title of the year.

Meanwhile, the top-seeded Women's Doubles pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand have also lived up to their billing, advancing to the final as they chase a remarkable hat-trick of titles at this Super 300 event. Their consistent performance underscores their dominance on home turf. While the spotlight shines on these finalists, Men's Singles saw an early exit for HS Prannoy, who fell in the opening round. The performances of other Indian shuttlers like Tanvi Patri and the Men's Doubles pair of Arjun & Hariharan, who navigated qualifiers, will be crucial for building depth in the national squad.
